note: Curated Microsoft Learn items and Saylor University courses. For each Microsoft Learn item the encoder proposed activities from the provider's title and summary; for each Saylor course the curator read the stated course learning outcomes. The curator kept only the links listed here (dwas), named the in-demand tools it teaches (tools, using O*NET software example names) and marked items that teach directing and checking AI output (ai_skill). Titles, URLs and durations come from the Microsoft Learn catalog API and from each Saylor course page when tools/build_catalogue.py runs. Route entries also record a coverage grade (introduces or practises), a practice checkpoint that produces an inspectable artifact and the entries they require first; Saylor states no prerequisites, so a requires link there is the curator's reading of the course sequence. families, where present, limits an entry to destination families in which its activities mean the same work (an activity such as "Test software performance" is unit testing for a developer but not for IT support).

items.checkpoint: Build a two-page site with HTML and CSS and keep its source in a repository.
Add a small script to your site and record how you checked it in the browser's developer tools.
Sketch two screens for an app and explain how each design choice serves its users.
List the accessibility requirements you would write into a website specification.
Draw a labelled diagram of a home or small-office network (router, switch, devices, address ranges) and list the order in which you would check for a connection fault.
Write a small program that solves a task from your own work (for example totalling a day's deliveries) and keep it in a repository.
Write tests for your program, including one that fails before a fix and passes after it.
Write an end-to-end test for one page of a site and a bug report for any failure you find.
Write and save the queries that answer five questions about a sample database.
Write a backup plan for a small office: what is backed up, how often, where it is kept and how a restore is tested.
List the monthly health checks you would run on the devices you support and what result counts as a problem.
Write a one-page note on how identity, access and data protection apply to a small shop's computers.
List the devices in a small office, the main threat to each and the control you would apply.
Build one dashboard page from a public dataset and note what question each chart answers.
Load a public dataset into Power BI and publish one report page.
Record a month of synthetic supplier invoices and customer receipts in a spreadsheet ledger and list what is outstanding.
Reconcile a synthetic bank statement against a cash book and explain each difference.
Produce a profit and loss statement and a balance sheet for a synthetic shop and write three observations.
Calculate the sales tax and withholding on a set of synthetic invoices and show the working.
Build an expense and asset register for a synthetic shop and compare it with the budget.
Build a yearly budget for a synthetic business with monthly figures and a variance column.
Issue three synthetic invoices, record the payments and produce an aged receivables list.
Summarise a synthetic sales sheet with formulas, then check every figure an AI assistant produced against them.
Record the commands you used to view and change a test machine's network settings, with the output before and after.
Write a one-page monitoring plan: the signals you would watch on a small network, the alert threshold for each and who is told.
Capture traffic for a failing connection on a test machine and write up what the capture showed.
Write a monthly maintenance checklist for the computers and network you look after.
Collect a performance baseline for one machine and note one finding with the counter that shows it.
Write a list of package-manager commands that installs and updates a standard set of applications, and test it on one machine.
Write a troubleshooting log for one real or practice problem: symptom, checks in order, cause, fix and how you confirmed it.
Write a one-page security policy for a small shop: passwords, updates, backups and who has admin rights.
Assess one small organisation's setup against five common threats and list a mitigation for each.
Document how user accounts and permissions are set up on a shared computer and one change that would reduce risk.
Review a home or office router's settings and record three changes that reduce network risk.
Write the account, group and password rules you would set for a ten-person office.
Refactor your earlier program into reusable functions and note what changed and why.
Load a public dataset, clean it and write three findings with the code that produced them.
Add parametrised tests and a fixture to your test suite and keep the run output.
Test one web page for accessibility and write three recommended changes with the problem each fixes.
Set up a project board for a small piece of work with an issue for each task and its status.
Write a one-page specification for a small app: its users, requirements and acceptance checks.
Review one app screen against inclusive design principles and propose two changes.
Design the tables for a small booking system and note how you would investigate a slow query.
Write a debugging log for one bug: how you reproduced it, what you inspected, the fix and the test that proves it.
Draw a data-flow diagram of an app you know and label where data is stored and sent.
Review a small web app against the OWASP Top 10 and list each risk found with its fix.
Draw up a chart of accounts for a small business you know and post five sample transactions.
Prepare a month's journal entries and a trial balance for a synthetic shop in a spreadsheet.
Build a 12-month budget in a spreadsheet with actual and budget columns and a variance for each month.
Write a one-page monthly report for a manager from your synthetic accounts, with one chart.
Assess three synthetic customers' payment histories and recommend a credit limit for each with reasons.
Pick a public dataset and write the question, the analysis steps and the answer for one business question.
Describe each stage of the analytics process for one dataset you know, from source to report.
Write the requirements for a report: its audience, questions, measures and refresh frequency.
Build a monthly budget and an invoice template for a synthetic small shop, with a formula behind every total.
Summarise a synthetic year of shop expenses by category and month with SUMIFS and a lookup, and write what the totals show.
Turn a synthetic sales table into a filtered table and two charts, one with a trendline, and write two sentences on what they show.
Build a one-page dashboard from a synthetic dataset for a manager, then list any chart that could mislead and how you fixed it.
Ask an AI assistant for the formulas that summarise a synthetic expense sheet, check each result by hand and record any it got wrong.
Write a one-page step-by-step procedure for a task you already do (for example restoring a backup), revise it with the course's editing strategies and keep both drafts.
Write a one-page brief on a recent tool or practice in your target field from three sources, with your search terms and why you trusted each source.
Prepare a budget and debt summary for a synthetic household and write three pieces of advice, each tied to a figure.
Compute five ratios from a listed company's published statements and write what they say about it.
Record a month of synthetic transactions for a small shop, produce its trial balance, income statement and balance sheet, and note one internal control you would add.
Write replies to three synthetic customer complaints, one by email, and an escalation note for the one you cannot resolve.
Analyse a synthetic customer dataset, report three findings with one chart each and state the limits of the data.
Plan the IP addressing and subnets for a synthetic three-department office and document the plan in a table.
Assess one computer you look after (or the module's example) for Windows 11 and write an upgrade recommendation naming each requirement it meets or misses.
Ask an AI assistant to draft a monthly cost summary from a synthetic ledger, then check every figure against your own totals and note each correction.
Compute liquidity, profitability and debt ratios for a listed company from its published statements and write five sentences on what they say about it.
Build a loan repayment table in a spreadsheet for a synthetic car loan and check the monthly payment against the unit's formula.
Value one bond and one dividend-paying share with the unit's formulas and compare each value with its market price.
Compute the expected return and spread of a two-share portfolio from synthetic yearly returns, and say how adding the second share changes the risk.
Compute the NPV, IRR and payback of two synthetic projects in a spreadsheet and recommend one in a short memo.
Prepare a twelve-week cash forecast for a synthetic small shop and mark the weeks when it would need short-term credit.
For three questions from a business you know, write which kind of model (regression, classification or clustering) would answer each and why.
Train a regression model on a public dataset in a notebook and write down its error on rows it did not see.
Group a public customer dataset into clusters in a notebook and describe each group in one sentence.
